title: GoalSpec
description: Root artifact capturing the why and what of a project. Source of truth for all downstream specs. Version 4.0.0.

tbd.description: Marker for fields that are intentionally incomplete pending more information.

planguageLevel.description: A Planguage threshold value or TBD marker. Use 'TBD' prefix when value is not yet known.

version.description: Semver version of this goalspec document instance.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the GoalSpec schema this document conforms to. Must be '4.0.0'.

project.description: Short human-readable project name. Used as a key across all downstream specs.

objective.description: Concise description of what is being built, for whom, and why.

statement.description: One or two sentences describing the system. Must NOT mention implementation, technology, or architecture.

for.description: Primary intended user or user group.

problem.description: The specific problem this solves that is not solved today.

confirmedAfterCompletion.description: True when the objective has been re-read and confirmed after all other sections were completed.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) that this objective's key concepts map to. Use for cross-spec traceability.

functionalRequirements.description: Observable capabilities the system must provide. Each must be independently testable and owned by one actor.

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this requirement (e.g. 'Paper Import').

description.description: Observable behaviour in plain language. Must not describe implementation or contain measurable thresholds.

actor.description: The specific role that owns this requirement. Avoid generic 'user' if a more specific actor exists.

priority.description: Implementation priority. P0 = must have, P1 = should have, P2 = could have, P3 = won't have now.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context. Must not contain implementation details.

fnRefs.description: FN-IDs from ApiSpec that implement this requirement. Populated during architecture phase. Use for REQ→FN traceability. At least one must be present once implementation begins.

scRefs.description: SC-IDs from this GoalSpec that measure this requirement. Populated when success criteria are written. At least one must be present.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced by this requirement's description.

reqRefs.description: REQ-NNN-slug IDs from GoalSpec that this requirement implements.

nfrRefs.description: NFR-NNN-slug IDs from GoalSpec that this requirement is related to.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Quality attributes in Planguage format. Every NFR must have Scale and Meter defined or explicitly marked TBD.

name.description: Short descriptive name for this NFR (e.g. 'Response Time', 'Error Recovery').

description.description: Plain-language description of the quality requirement. Should explain what is being measured and why.

scale.description: What is measured and in what unit. If unknown, prefix with 'TBD'.

meter.description: How it will be measured — tool, condition, methodology. If unknown, prefix with 'TBD'.

must.description: Minimum acceptable threshold. Below this the system fails.

plan.description: Realistic target the team is aiming for. Use 'TBD' if unknown.

wish.description: Ideal outcome if conditions allow. Use 'TBD' if unknown.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this NFR.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in the NFR's scale/meter descriptions. Optional — NFRs are measurement-focused.

conRefs.description: CON-NNN-slug IDs from ArchitectureSpec constraints that stem from this NFR

userStories.description: Desired outcomes from user perspectives. Every story must link to at least one functional requirement.

id.description: Unique identifier for this user story.

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this user story (e.g. 'Start Research Session').

description.description: Plain-language description of the user story. May restate capability+outcome in a single sentence for graph visualization. If omitted, capability+outcome are used as fallback.

actor.description: Specific role. Must match or be consistent with actors named in functional requirements.

capability.description: What the actor wants to do. Must express a goal, not a feature or implementation detail.

outcome.description: Why the actor wants this — the benefit they receive.

reqRefs.description: REQ-IDs this story motivates. Must not be empty.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this user story.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced by this story's capability or outcome descriptions.

successCriteria.description: Binary, independently verifiable conditions that determine the project is complete.

id.description: Unique identifier for this success criterion.

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this success criterion (e.g. 'Report Addresses Question').

description.description: A concrete, binary pass/fail condition. Must not be subjective.

refs.description: References to the FR(s) or NFR(s) this criterion gates. At least one must be present.

verificationMethod.description: How this criterion will be verified — automated test, manual check, load test, etc.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this success criterion.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced by this success criterion's description.

nonGoals.description: Explicit capabilities this project will NOT attempt to solve.

capability.description: Specific named capability being excluded. Must not be vague.

reason.description: Why it is excluded: deferred, out of scope, handled elsewhere, etc.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) for the excluded capability. Use for cross-spec traceability.

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this non-goal

description.description: Plain-language description of why this capability is excluded
